text: New moon. The close is black.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They did not hang this one. They waited. Ten years, and then a Sunday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They say he asked to see his wife and the son born after they took him, and was told he might, if he'd go once to their church. And would not. I don't know that it's true. It's the kind of thing that's told.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Southwell in February, by the rope. This one by waiting. The same winter, near enough.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My father will hear it at the shop door and say something merry about the price of lime.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I've a king at Pomfret who peoples his prison with his own thoughts, and the yard pities him for a penny. No. Too neat. Leave the man his own death.
